title: Sharp / animated type range

location.extent: Complete published clip; PNG is a frame at 0.5 seconds

slide_intent: Demonstrate width and weight together because type variation changes the voice and rhythm of the same word.
strategic_value: A broad typographic range can make Dropbox’s expression flexible while retaining a shared letter family.
demonstration: Six colored cells repeatedly change their size and the width and weight of the word Sharp; small numbers accompany the specimens.
practical_value: Compare narrow, broad, light and heavy treatments using identical content.

content_islands.name: Specimen grid
content_islands.spec: Maintain three columns and two rows while cell proportions and letterforms change.

content_islands.name: Sample identifiers
content_islands.spec: Keep the small numbers attached to their specimens; they are not motion durations.
